ActorTalk: What a coincidence! I was just talking about you with my Commandant!
We were just discussing your performance in those major battles from before. Also, I'm your former Commandant, to be precise.
Even if you're retired, you will always be my Commandant in my heart!
Yes, although we've never met, I participated in the Puria Forest Park Battle just like you.
I was responsible for guerrilla operations and logistics in that battle. Though I survived thanks to my comrades' protection, I developed a severe respiratory illness.
After undergoing a series of examinations, I received notification that I could no longer be deployed to the front lines, so I had no choice but to retire.
While I'm delighted to hear you say that, I can't allow you to shoulder so much alone. Logistics support shines in its own right too, you know.
I'll work hard to make up for your absence.
